recordedWith: @remotion/transitions@4.0.535, driven through @remotion/player in jsdom for the timelines
how: A scratch script outside the repo that only calls the published package public API (and renders it with the public Player in jsdom) and writes what it observes to JSON. Remotion is not a dependency of this repo. Presentations are recorded as the CSS style they render; the timelines with a presentation that only reports its direction and progress.
